text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Happiness is here, come this new year!
Happy
New Year to the both of you,
Trainer and Do—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait... Where's Doto?

We had plans to spend New Year's
together, but
I've been waiting a while,
and Meisho Doto has
yet to turn up.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huuuuh?! I'm sure we promised to
celebrate New
Year's together...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Sniff! Traineeer, where are youuu?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Oh? Isn't that... Ayabe? She's all by
herself...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder what she's praying for. She
looks so
serious, and also... so lonely.)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, she's on the move... Should I
really... just
leave her alone?)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh... U-um, A-Aya... Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, it's you... What is it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Well... Um...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-I'll g-get you some takoyaki, my
treat!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Huh... So I looked that down? And that's
why
you...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Well, y-yeah. And... a-also to
congratulate you
on your win at
Hanshin...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That explains the takoyaki, then...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I know you're only trying to be
considerate.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, don't, don't say that! I mean...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You... seemed so serious when you were
praying...
What did you... wish for?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What are you racing for?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: What am I... racing for?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah. What's the reason?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-well, um... I would like to become
more
confident... I think...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I see. As for me... I race for my other self.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
For my younger sister... the one I lost the
day we
were born.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I have to run well enough for both of us.
I have to
shine for her—that's the most I
can do to atone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So... I made a promise at this shrine.
During my
classic year, I'm going to win
as many races as I
can for my sister.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: For your sister... So that's...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's my reason. If I came across as
stern to
you, that's why.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
What do you say to accepting that
information as
payment for the
takoyaki? I need to be going
now.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer! It's Doto, I found her!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Waaahaaah!

Meisho Doto bursts into tears the
moment we
find her. I calm her down
before asking what's
wrong.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how tragic... I didn't know Ayabe
had such an
unlucky past...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I got it all wrong...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was my body that's not good
enough,
but it's really my heart. My
feelings... aren't
enough.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe is shouldering such a heavy
mission, but
she's still running to honor
her sister's memory.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O's like that too. She once told
me that
she's destined to shine
happiness upon all the
people in the
world.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And then there's me, only running for
myself. For
some selfish illusions of
confidence...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I may train... it
could never
get me anywheeere...
Waaah!

I can feel her pain through the anguish in
her
voice. However...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, don't cry, Doto! Please don't cry!
There is
hope for you, surely!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure your trainer has a few choice
words that
will cheer you right up. Come
on, Trainer, say
something!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Because the heart has growth spurts too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So my heart's going through the same
thing... as
my body? Oh... I didn't know.
So... that's why my
ambitions are small?
choice_data_list: The heart has... growth spurts too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yup, you've got that right! It won't be
too long
until you start thinking big!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You've still got a long way to go, Doto.
Give it
some time, and with luck, things
will start going
your way.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, maybe you're right... That would
be... nice.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll choose to believe you two. I
would like
to do more things that will
help me grow.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm! That's a great idea. In fact,
let's start
off the new year with a
challenge. Trainer, what
should we do?

This could be a good opportunity to
have her let
off some steam. Now, what
would be an
appropriate activity?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a mountain hike sounds like great
fun! I'll
see you when you've returned!
choice_data_list: Exploring the department store food hall
A variety of New Year's games.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waaagh, it's a suspension bridge!
Th-there's no
way I can do this.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I can see it now—it'll start wobbling, I'll
slip, and
then I'll fall right off!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-b-b-but I can't keep being a coward...
I need to
challenge myself!
choice_data_list: Then do you want to pass on it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Three, two,one, GO! Kyaaaagh!
Crack! Creak!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh thank goodness, I made it over alive!

Meisho Doto just barely makes it across
the
bridge—a bit more courageous than
before.

All of these little experiences will keep
adding up.
I think that this year, I'll start
encouraging her to
let her dreams grow
bigger.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, that sounds like a blast! You've
gotta
check out the lucky bags they've
got on sale for
New Year's!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Trainer... It's the sweets corner.
Look at all
these lovely delectables.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
What? It's okay to buy some for
ourselves? Oh,
what a wonderful way to
start the year!
choice_data_list: Shall we eat in the trainer's office?

text_block_list.text:
Growth needs nurturing. Since she
started off the
day in tears, I'll have to
make sure she fully
recuperates, with the
help of some comforting
food.

On the way home, I suddenly have a

thought—there's no need to rush. This
spring, our
journey should be walked
slow and steady.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, some New Year's fun! Let's fly
kites and
spin tops!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waaaagh... Traineeer, my kite hit the
ground and
got ripped to pieces.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waaagh... I threw the top too hard—oh,
no, no,
nooo...

Meisho Doto flies into her usual panic.
But our
fun activities have left her with a
few new tricks.

And it dawns on me, there's no need to
rush. This
spring, our journey up should
be walked slow and
steady.
